det44.intro: Deterministic CGNAT (DET44): every inside host gets a fixed outside address and port block, so logs need only the mapping. Enabling DET44 cannot be undone until the data plane restarts.

calc.title: Port-block calculator
calc.intro: What a DET44 mapping gives each subscriber: 64512 ports (1024–65535) per outside address, split evenly.
calc.ratio: Sharing ratio: {{ratio}} inside hosts per outside address

error.outside-larger: The outside prefix must not be larger than the inside prefix.
error.ratio-too-large: At most 15 bits between the prefixes (32768 hosts per address).

dslite.title: DS-Lite
dslite.intro: DS-Lite AFTR: IPv4 over IPv6 from B4 elements, translated to the pool. The AFTR and B4 addresses are data-plane globals.

map.intro: MAP-E, MAP-T and lw4o6 border relay: domains are shared; each interface either encapsulates (MAP-E, lw4o6) or translates (MAP-T). An lw4o6 domain needs per-PSID rules.

cnat.intro: CNAT: service VIPs load-balanced to backends, and an SNAT policy. A policy needs SNAT addresses; CNAT and NAT44-ED cannot share an interface. The CNAT feature is enabled on the SNAT policy interfaces.

pnat.intro: PNAT policy 1:1 NAT (IPv4): a binding matches fields of a packet and rewrites others; attach it to an interface's input or output path. Bindings on one interface and point must match the same fields.
